title: Acceptance environment descriptor
description: Describes a target deployment so the portable probes (kit/acceptance/probes/) can run against it. One descriptor per deployment; kit/acceptance/environments/lab.yaml is the reference lab's, and TEMPLATE.yaml is the annotated starting point for a customer. Sections that are absent disable the probes that need them (the conformance profile records this as partial coverage).

issuer.description: The single hub issuer (HUB_ISSUER). Exact string the probes assert iss against (IDN-01).

jwks_uri.description: Override for the JWKS endpoint; defaults to <issuer>/protocol/openid-connect/certs.

gateways.description: Base URLs of the tier gateways. The external URL is where an internal token is replayed to prove the tier wall (TIER-02).

probe_endpoints.description: Paths (appended to a gateway base) the probes exercise.

acl_resource.description: A resource behind the tier wall AND a group ACL — used for tier-replay and scope-vs-group probes (e.g. /fhir/Patient).

scheduling_mcp.description: A stateless first-party MCP server path for statelessness + step-up probes (e.g. /scheduling/mcp).

fhir_clinical_mcp.description: The compartmented FHIR MCP server path (e.g. /fhir-clinical/mcp).

egress.description: Present enables the EG-* egress/DLP/broker probes.

route.description: Full URL of a governed egress route.

tool.description: A vendor MCP tool to invoke (e.g. create_issue).

clean_args.description: Tool arguments with no sensitive identifiers (must pass DLP).

name.description: Pattern name the audit record must carry.

sample.description: A string matching the pattern, planted to prove the block. NEVER a real identifier.

broker.description: Present enables the no-issuance and hub-validation broker probes (EG-04/05).

issuance_paths_absent.description: Paths that MUST 404 — proving the broker exposes no token/JWKS surface.

audit.description: Present with backend=loki enables the AU-* audit-join probes.

identities.description: Named principals the probes reference. A probe that needs an undeclared identity is skipped.

acquire.description: scripted = built-in auth-code+PKCE driver (dev IdPs with scriptable login). command = run a shell command that prints a fresh access token. env = read a token from an env var. For real customer IdPs, command/env is the norm.

dpop.description: scripted only: bind cnf.jkt via a DPoP proof at the token endpoint.

expects_compartment.description: This identity's token must carry fhir_patient (customer path).

command.description: acquire=command: shell command printing an access token to stdout.

env.description: acquire=env: environment variable holding an access token.

username_env.description: Env var holding the username, when it is itself sensitive (e.g. an email).

password_env.description: Env var holding the password (never inline the secret).

claim_vectors.description: Optional: run the claim-shape unit layer, signing kit/blueprints/vectors/ with an ephemeral key against the deployment's schema.

vectors_dir.description: Defaults to ../blueprints/vectors relative to the framework.
